step1.title: Welcome to Musanad admin
step1.body: You're signed in as a Platform Admin. The left sidebar gives you access to every area of the system — contracts, templates, regulations, and more.

step2.title: User management lives here
step2.body: Open Admin → Users to invite teammates, assign roles, suspend accounts, or impersonate a user for support.

step3.title: Approval chains are customisable
step3.body: Admin → Approval Matrix lets you design routing rules per contract type and value band. Changes apply to new contracts immediately.

step4.title: Reset when you need to re-run the demo
step4.body: Use ⌘K → 'Reset demo data' (or visit /admin/reset?key=…) to restore the seed state in seconds.
